Fiscal.Step.Header: Close Fiscal Year — current year starts {0:yyyy-MM-dd}

Fiscal.Intro.Body:
Closing the fiscal year simulates a "fresh start" without deleting a single record:

• Step 1 — Physical count: count the goods and post differences (cornerstone of closing).
• Step 2 — Readiness checks: no open sessions, no old held invoices, no pending payrolls.
• Step 3 — Archiving: automatic full backup + annual PDF report.
• Step 4 — Year rollover: default reports start from the new year,
   old dates remain for reading and year-over-year comparison — editing before it is locked.

Current year: from {0:yyyy-MM-dd} to today.
Fiscal.Checks.ReadyBody: All checks passed — you may continue.
Fiscal.Checks.CannotClose: ✖ Cannot close until blocking items (red) are resolved
Fiscal.Archive.Intro:
Archiving before rollover — nothing is deleted:

• Full database backup (restorable anytime)
• Final annual PDF report (profits, expenses and sessions)
Fiscal.Archive.MsgReportFailed: Could not generate the annual report: {0}
Fiscal.Close.Intro:
Final step: fiscal year rollover.

Set the new fiscal year start date (usually today). Default reports will start from it,
and earlier dates become read/comparison only — editing old payrolls will be rejected.
